posts.body:
Tutorial topics:
Installation, Map Creation, Events, Character Setup, Asset Management, and many other topics
Brief description:
A comprehensive collection of tutorials covering the essentials of RPG Maker Unite from installation to advanced game development features
Requirements:
RPG Maker Unite, Unity
About:
These tutorials cover essential aspects of RPG Maker Unite:
Installation and setup
Editor navigation
Map creation and design
Tile management
Asset conversion
Event implementation
Character configuration
DLC integration
Resource importing
UI customization
Battle system setup
Parameter settings
Equipment systems
Visual effects
Plus many other topics
